news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 2 experienced directors. 3 highly experienced directors. 2 independent directors (3 non-independent directors). Non-Executive Independent Director Manish Pande was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2021. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Insufficient board refreshment.

news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 18%
news.body: After last week's 18% share price decline to ₹122, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 6.6x. Average trailing P/E is 27x in the Basic Materials industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 35% over the past three years.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price gain to ₹179, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 9.7x. Average trailing P/E is 31x in the Basic Materials industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 124% over the past three years.
